Contractual Obligations

As of June 30, 2026, our non-cancelable contractual commitments were $349.31 billion, primarily related to network infrastructure, servers and data center construction.

As of June 30, 2026, we had additional operating leases that have not yet commenced with future lease payments of $41.2 billion.

In July 2026, we entered into additional data center leases that have not yet commenced with total future payments of approximately $68 billion.
